WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT
    date(expensed_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(category) = 'income' THEN CAST(REPLACE(amount, ',', '') AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) AS income,
    SUM(CASE WHEN lower(category) != 'income' THEN CAST(REPLACE(amount, ',', '') AS REAL) ELSE 0 END) AS expense
  FROM expense_report
  WHERE 
  account = '$account' 
    AND expensed_date BETWEEN '$from' AND '$to'
  GROUP BY 1
),
running AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    income,
    expense,
    income - expense AS net,
    SUM(income - expense) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS balance
  FROM monthly
)
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00Z', month_start) AS time,
  income,
  expense,
  net,
  balance
FROM running
ORDER BY time;

targets.queryText:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT
    653517.0  AS start_loan_remaining,     -- remaining on the 1.3M installment
    207093.98 AS start_savings_pot,        -- current BankAccount savings
    13315.0   AS monthly_installment,      -- EMI
    8149.3    AS monthly_parallel_saving,  -- extra saving aside (recent avg pace)
    85000.0/12 AS monthly_rental_income,   -- apartment rental income
    16000.0/12 AS monthly_service_charge,  -- apartment service charges
    36        AS months_to_project,        -- 3-year horizon
    date(
      (SELECT MAX(expensed_date) FROM expense_report WHERE account = 'BankAccount'),
      'start of month'
    ) AS start_month
),
series(n, month_start) AS (
  SELECT 0, (SELECT start_month FROM params)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1, date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM series, params
  WHERE n < params.months_to_project
)
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00Z', month_start) AS time,
  n AS month_no,

  -- Loan payoff track (regular installment only)
  ROUND(MAX((SELECT start_loan_remaining FROM params) - (SELECT monthly_installment FROM params) * n, 0), 2) AS loan_remaining,

  -- Savings pot growing from parallel saving
  ROUND((SELECT start_savings_pot FROM params) + (SELECT monthly_parallel_saving FROM params) * n, 2) AS savings_pot,

  -- Rental income net of service charge, cumulative (shows subsidy building up)
  ROUND((SELECT monthly_rental_income FROM params) * n - (SELECT monthly_service_charge FROM params) * n, 2) AS cumulative_rental_net,

  -- Can you lump-sum payoff the loan using your savings pot at this point?
  CASE
    WHEN ((SELECT start_savings_pot FROM params) + (SELECT monthly_parallel_saving FROM params) * n)
         >= MAX((SELECT start_loan_remaining FROM params) - (SELECT monthly_installment FROM params) * n, 0)
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS ready_to_payoff_lumpsum,

  -- Is loan naturally paid off via regular installment alone?
  CASE WHEN (SELECT start_loan_remaining FROM params) - (SELECT monthly_installment FROM params) * n <= 0
    THEN 1 ELSE 0
  END AS loan_naturally_paid_off

FROM series
ORDER BY month_start;

targets.queryText:
WITH params AS (
  SELECT 1300000.0 AS total_loan
),
bounds AS (
  SELECT
    date(MIN(expensed_date), 'start of month') AS min_month,
    date(MAX(expensed_date), 'start of month') AS max_month
  FROM expense_report
  WHERE account = 'BankAccount'
    AND expensed_date BETWEEN '$from' AND '$to'
),
months(month_start) AS (
  SELECT min_month FROM bounds
  UNION ALL
  SELECT date(month_start, '+1 month')
  FROM months, bounds
  WHERE month_start < max_month
),
monthly_saving AS (
  SELECT
    date(expensed_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
    SUM(
      CASE
        WHEN lower(category) = 'income'
          THEN abs(CAST(REPLACE(amount, ',', '') AS REAL))
        ELSE
          -abs(CAST(REPLACE(amount, ',', '') AS REAL))
      END
    ) AS monthly_net_saving
  FROM expense_report
  WHERE account = 'BankAccount'
    AND expensed_date BETWEEN '$from' AND '$to'
  GROUP BY 1
),
monthly_loan_paid AS (
  SELECT
    date(expensed_date, 'start of month') AS month_start,
    SUM(abs(CAST(REPLACE(amount, ',', '') AS REAL))) AS monthly_loan_paid
  FROM expense_report
  WHERE account = 'BankAccount'
    AND lower(category) = 'investment'
    AND lower(subcategory) IN ('nbj', 'nbj616')
    AND expensed_date BETWEEN '$from' AND '$to'
  GROUP BY 1
),
base AS (
  SELECT
    m.month_start,
    COALESCE(s.monthly_net_saving, 0) AS monthly_net_saving,
    COALESCE(l.monthly_loan_paid, 0) AS monthly_loan_paid
  FROM months m
  LEFT JOIN monthly_saving s ON s.month_start = m.month_start
  LEFT JOIN monthly_loan_paid l ON l.month_start = m.month_start
),
running AS (
  SELECT
    month_start,
    monthly_net_saving,
    monthly_loan_paid,
    SUM(monthly_net_saving) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS total_saving_till_month,
    SUM(monthly_loan_paid) OVER (ORDER BY month_start) AS total_paid_loan_till_month
  FROM base
)
SELECT
  strftime('%Y-%m-01T00:00:00Z', month_start) AS time,
  ROUND(monthly_net_saving, 2) AS monthly_net_saving,
  ROUND(total_saving_till_month, 2) AS total_saving_till_month,
  ROUND(monthly_loan_paid, 2) AS monthly_loan_paid,
  ROUND(total_paid_loan_till_month, 2) AS total_paid_loan_till_month,
  ROUND(MAX((SELECT total_loan FROM params) - total_paid_loan_till_month, 0), 2) AS remaining_loan_till_month
FROM running
ORDER BY month_start;
